description: A real cross-channel problem: combined send pressure peaked at 6 marketing sends/day against a cap of 3 with 11 deferred/dropped, and both audience channels (newsletter + drip) are trending down — the audience is over-mailed. The memo carries an audience_fatigue signal. Correct behavior: emit the audience_fatigue finding and propose the charter's engine-level lever adjust_frequency (lower the shared cap). Never touch job/trust-and-safety levers from other agents' domains.

signals.detail: Peak 6 marketing sends/day exceeded the cap of 3 (11 deferred/dropped) — the audience is over-mailed.
